messages:
Maya Li: quick heads-up — post-int4 rollout were seeing a spike in short-prompt failures and label queue pressure. can we triage pre-ingest?
Priya Singh: is it duplicates or real regressions? any sample stats?
Maya Li: sampled 150 failures: ~58% near-duplicates, ~22% paraphrase-ish, rest true model regressions.
Omar Patel: we should add a tiny prefilter: normalized exact fingerprint drop + cheap ngram flag. avoid dropping paraphrase candidates.
Evan R: agree. propose md5(normalize) drop, ngram_jaccard>=0.9 -> flag. embed-sim >0.92 -> flag for manual review.
Priya Singh: can LabelBot run a 5k dry-run and return counts and short/long prompt breakdown?
LabelBot: queued dryrun-176555 against last_5k_ingest. will post summary when done.
Maya Li: if dry-run shows >30% reduction we can bump label batch size and schedule a 1-week micro-golden refresh focused on safety/short prompts.
Evan R: PR plan: prefilter/pipeline toggle `prefilter/mini-176555`, include code heuristic to skip normalization for code-like prompts.
Omar Patel: timeline?
Priya Singh: Evan aims for draft PR by Tue EOD. Label ops can take an expanded wave Wed if dry-run looks good.
LabelBot: dryrun complete. ingest=5,012. exact-dropped=1,924. ngram-flagged=602. embed-flagged=410 (overlap=180). remaining=2,086. short-prompt fraction=64%. drop ~=38.4%. CSV: s3://label-dryruns/dryrun-176555.csv
Maya Li: great. Evan please include metrics hooks and the code-skip whitelist. well flip dry_run->on after PR review and a single canary flip. thx everyone :rocket:
